history.period: Established 1960s, after the 1959 exile of the 14th Dalai Lama
history.summary: NOT A HINDU TEMPLE - keep-or-drop decision needed. This is a Tibetan Buddhist complex in McLeod Ganj, the spiritual heart of the Tibetan exile community, centred on the Tsuglagkhang (the 'central cathedral', named after Lhasa's Jokhang). Built by Tibetan refugees after the 14th Dalai Lama, Tenzin Gyatso, fled Tibet in 1959 and settled in Dharamshala (1960). The main temple houses a 3-m gilded bronze Shakyamuni Buddha flanked by Padmasambhava and Avalokiteshvara (facing Tibet). The complex includes the Namgyal Monastery (the Dalai Lama's personal monastery, founded 1564-65 in Tibet by the 2nd Dalai Lama Gendun Gyatso and re-established here after 1959), the Tibet Museum, the Kalachakra Temple, and lies opposite the Dalai Lama's residence. DUPLICATE: CSV row 367 'Tsuglagkhang Complex' is the same site - the Tsuglagkhang is the central/main temple of this complex. The complex is managed by the Tibetan administration-in-exile.

name: Dalai Lama Temple Complex
town_description: McLeod Ganj (Upper Dharamshala) in Kangra district is the seat of the 14th Dalai Lama and the Central Tibetan Administration (Tibetan government-in-exile), and the global centre of the Tibetan exile community.

travel.airport: Kangra Airport (Gaggal, DHM), about 15 km from McLeod Ganj; taxis readily available.
travel.railway: Pathankot Junction, about 85 km, is the nearest major railhead; the narrow-gauge Kangra Valley Railway runs Pathankot to Jogindernagar.
travel.road: In the centre of McLeod Ganj on Temple Road; 10-15 minutes on foot from Mall Road, about 5 km uphill from Dharamshala; the Tibet Museum inside closes on Mondays.

visitor_information.best_time: March to June and September to November for clear weather; the Dalai Lama's public teachings (often in spring) are announced on dalailama.com - check dates before planning.
visitor_information.opening_hours: 5:00 AM-8:00 PM daily in most sources (thehosteller, justdial, triphobo); trawell.in reports seasonal hours (6 AM-6 PM winter, 5 AM-7 PM summer) - verify. Photography is not allowed inside the main temple; remove shoes and dress modestly.
